### Libraries
``` {r}
library(tidyverse)
library(broom)
library(knitr)
library(scales)
```

# Read and clean Baltimore data
``` {r read_process_data}
homicides <- read_csv("../data/homicide-data.csv") %>% 
  mutate(city_name = paste0(city, ", ", state),
         reported_date = ymd(reported_date))
# break pipe to preserve full dataset for other analysis
balt <- homicides %>% 
  filter(city_name == "Baltimore, MD") %>% 
  mutate(year = year(reported_date), 
         month = month(reported_date, label = T, abbr = F))
```

# Create monthly plot
``` {r monthly_plot, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 2.5}
# define months in each season
summer <- month.name[5:10]
winter <- month.name[c(1:4,11:12)]
# save date of freddie gray arrest
fg_arrest <- tibble(date = mdy("April 12, 2015"))
# make monthly plot
balt %>% 
  group_by(year, month) %>% 
  summarise(monthly_hom = n()) %>%
  mutate(month_year = my(paste0(month, year)), 
         season = case_when(month %in% summer ~ "Summer",
                            month %in% winter ~ "Winter")) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = month_year, y = monthly_hom)) +
  scale_fill_discrete(palette = c("#c4c4c4", "#acd8e5")) +
  geom_col(aes(fill = season)) +
  geom_smooth(se = FALSE, span = 0.1) +
  geom_vline(data = fg_arrest, 
             xintercept = fg_arrest$date, 
             color = "red", 
             linewidth = 1.5, 
             linetype = 2) +
  theme_dark() +
  ggtitle("Homicides in Baltimore, MD") +
  xlab("Date") +
  ylab("Monthly homicides") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", 
        legend.title = element_blank())
```
